fusions.name: Unrelenting Jaws
fusions.desc: A grinding bite that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Grinding Circle
fusions.desc: A grinding turn that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cold Plating
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Grey Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
